info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Proofs-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Proofs API provides a streamlined method for accessing documentation related to logistics shipments. It allows users to retrieve proof of shipment details, ensuring transparency and verification of logistics processes. Common consumers include supply chain managers, logistics operators, and customer service representatives seeking shipment verification data. This API is essential for enhancing operational efficiency and facilitating effective communication between stakeholders in the logistics ecosystem.
